basic_details.job_title: CURAJ Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Office Assistant, Project Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: CURAJ Incubation Foundation, Central University of Rajasthan, is hiring a Project Coordinator (₹75,000 per month, fixed), a Project Assistant (₹25,000 per month, fixed) and an Office Assistant (₹15,000 per month, fixed) for its BIRAC-supported E-YUVA Center. The posts are contractual for one year at first and are co-terminus with the project. Eligible Indian nationals can apply online through a separate Google Form for each post from 26 October 2026 until 15 November 2026 (11:59 PM).

content_sections.heading: About CURAJ
content_sections.text: Central University of Rajasthan (CURAJ) is a central university in Rajasthan. Its CURAJ Incubation Foundation runs the E-YUVA Center, which is supported by BIRAC. According to the notice, the center's work covers innovation and entrepreneurship in the biotechnology/bio-pharma domain: it mentors fellows and startups, holds technical workshops and supports product-oriented research.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from eligible and suitable Indian nationals. Each post has its own essential qualification and age limit. The age limit for every post is counted as on the last date of application. Essential: Ph.D. in any branch of Life Sciences/ Biotechnology/ Microbiology/Agriculture/ Pharmacy, with at least: 3 years of post-Ph.D. experience in Teaching / Research / Industry Out of these 3 years, at least one year should be in Innovation, Intellectual property and/or entrepreneurship Desirable: proven experience in setting up startups, due diligence and organizing startup events. The notice also lists these desirable points for the Project Coordinator post: Strong interest and passion for nurturing technology innovation and entrepreneurship Academic background in life sciences, bioengineering, biotechnology, biomedical engineering, medicine or allied disciplines (preferred for bio-incubation activities) Experience/qualification in business management, IP management, project management, technology transfer, incubation, law and agreements Excellent communication skills; experience in scientific/proposal writing is desirable Experience in mentoring students, interns or startups will be an advantage Self-starter with the ability to work independently and deliver project goals Ability to design programs, mobilize applicants and generate revenue through scientific/technology-based workshops Note: research and innovation capacity must be evidenced through publications, patents, or startups created/mentored. Age: maximum 45 years as on the last date of application. Relaxation may be provided for highly experienced candidates. Essential: B.Tech / M.Sc / M.Tech in Life Sciences / Biotechnology / Microbiology / Environmental science / M.Pharm. Desirable: one year of experience in Innovation, Intellectual property and/or entrepreneurship. The other desirable points are: Strong interest in research, innovation and entrepreneurship Hands-on experience with analytical instruments, BSL-2 laboratory, animal handling (preferred) Experience/qualification in business management, IP, project management, technology transfer, incubation Good communication skills with experience in scientific writing/content development Self-motivated and capable of working under strict deadlines Willingness to travel for outreach, summits and collaborative programs Age: maximum 35 years as on the last date of application. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All three salaries are fixed monthly amounts. The Project Coordinator (₹75,000) and Project Assistant (₹25,000) salaries come "with scope of 5% annual increment". The notice prints no such line for the Office Assistant (₹15,000). Selected candidates are not entitled to any other benefits that are admissible to the regular employees of the Central University of Rajasthan. Appointments are purely temporary and contractual for one year, extendable up to three years (co-terminus with the project) based on performance. No claim for regularization will be entertained. The engagement gives no right to claim regular appointment in the University or continued services in the University. When the engagement period in the offer ends, the candidate is not required to report for duty unless the University grants an extension. The University reserves the right to terminate the engagement at any time, even before the stipulated period, for unsatisfactory performance, misconduct or any other administrative reasons / compulsions.

content_sections.heading: CURAJ Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Acts as the overall coordinator of the E-YUVA Center and reports directly to the Chief Coordinator / Principal Project Investigator (PI). Responsibilities include: Administrative, scientific and financial support Applicant mobilization, branding and outreach, revenue generation Mentoring fellows (UG to Post-Doctoral level) Organizing technical workshops and supporting product-oriented research Mentoring startups; assisting entrepreneurs in proposals, pitches, business plans and fund-raising Executing innovation and entrepreneurship activities in the biotechnology/bio-pharma domain Any other responsibility assigned by the Chief Coordinator/PI from time to time Provides scientific and administrative support to the E-YUVA Center and reports to the Project Coordinator/Chief Coordinator/PI. Duties include: Laboratory maintenance and monitoring instruments Coordination with fellows Procurement and project finance documentation Organizing seminars and workshops Assisting in proposal writing and fund-raising activities Maintaining day-to-day project operations Office and laboratory support Maintaining records and documentation Assisting in organizing seminars/workshops Mobilizing candidates Supporting target-based revenue generation activities of the E-YUVA Center Any additional duties assigned by the Project Coordinator/Chief Coordinator/PI Under the general conditions, every candidate will also have to perform other duties and work assigned by the Central University of Rajasthan from time to time.

Fill in the application form completely. Attach the supporting documents. Incomplete applications, or applications without supporting documents, will be rejected. Project Coordinator applicants must show their research and innovation capacity through publications, patents, or startups created/mentored. Submit the form by 15 November 2026, up to 11:59 PM. Applications received after the last date will not be considered and are liable to be summarily rejected. The notice does not list the supporting documents one by one. No interim correspondence will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The University reserves the right to conduct a Written Test, Skill Test, Presentation and/or Interview, as deemed necessary. The interview date will be announced later, and the schedule of interview will be published separately on the university website. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. If any dispute or ambiguity arises in the selection process, the decision of the University will be final.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CURAJ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies, 1 each for Project Coordinator, Project Assistant and Office Assistant at the E-YUVA Center. The notice does not print a number for each post, and the University may increase or decrease the number of posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CURAJ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 15 November 2026, up to 11:59 PM. Applications started on 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the CURAJ Project Coordinator post?
faq.answer: You need a Ph.D. in any branch of Life Sciences/ Biotechnology/ Microbiology/Agriculture/ Pharmacy and at least 3 years of post-Ph.D. experience in Teaching / Research / Industry. At least one of those years must be in Innovation, Intellectual property and/or entrepreneurship.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Project Assistant and Office Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Project Assistant needs a B.Tech / M.Sc / M.Tech in Life Sciences / Biotechnology / Microbiology / Environmental science / M.Pharm. Office Assistant needs an undergraduate degree (preferably in Life Sciences) with minimum 55% marks and proficiency in English and Computer Applications (MS Office).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CURAJ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The limit is a maximum of 45 years for Project Coordinator and a maximum of 35 years for Project Assistant and Office Assistant, as on the last date of application. Each post allows relaxation for experienced candidates as printed for it.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the CURAJ E-YUVA Center posts?
faq.answer: The fixed monthly salary is ₹75,000 for Project Coordinator, ₹25,000 for Project Assistant and ₹15,000 for Office Assistant. The first two posts come with scope of 5% annual increment.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for CURAJ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply through the Google Form for your post, attach your supporting documents and submit by 15 November 2026 (11:59 PM). Applications that are incomplete or have no supporting documents will be rejected.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CURAJ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The University reserves the right to conduct a Written Test, Skill Test, Presentation and/or Interview, as deemed necessary. The interview schedule will be published separately on the university website.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CURAJ E-YUVA Center job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointments are purely temporary and contractual for one year, extendable up to three years (co-terminus with the project) based on performance. No claim for regularization will be entertained.

faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
